Name: Abiathar, Son of Ahimelech
Summary: Abiathar, son of Ahimelech, alone escaped the massacre at Nob, fleeing to David with the ephod. He served as David's priest through his fugitive years and his reign, bringing the ephod whenever David inquired of God.
KeyStory: Abiathar escaped Nob with the ephod and carried God's guidance to David for forty years.
RelatedPeople: Ahimelech, Son of Ahitub; King David; Zadok, Son of Ahitub; Ahimelech, Son of Abiathar
LifeLesson: Surviving a massacre is not the end of a calling; Abiathar served a lifetime after his worst day.
